convention: FY2026 year-end anchor with later information; illustrative annual valuation, not a September target price or point-in-time backtest.

terminal_growth.reason: Editable long-run INR growth assumption, not company guidance.

terminal_roic.reason: Editable sustainable return on incremental capital; not the company ROE aspiration.

cash_exclusion.reason: Conservative: subtract 202 restricted + 1015 encumbered from cash equivalents, assuming no overlap and all in cash equivalents. Actual allocation across cash/other bank balances not disclosed. Other bank balances separately treated as operating collateral. Review to avoid excessive exclusion.

term_repayment.reason: FY27 uses disclosed current term maturities. Repeat this amount thereafter as a timing proxy; not a contractual annual maturity table.

term_rate.reason: Weighted rate proxy using disclosed non-current NCD 379 at 6.61% and other term debt 1155 at 9.25%. Applies this blend to current maturities; overseas loan mix not separately allocated.

working_rate.reason: Pooled FY25-26 borrowing interest / average debt. These two intervals use all three year-end debt balances. Proxy for revolving facility pricing, not a lender quote.

lease_rate.reason: Three-year lease interest (2+1+0) / sum year-end lease liabilities (83+44+29). Rounded statements give only a proxy, not a contractual lease rate.

land_capex_share.reason: No new land purchase forecast found; existing land retained.

software_capex_share.reason: Latest disclosed capital expenditure split: software 1 out of total 52.

dividend_payout_tail.reason: Sum FY24-26 declared DPS / sum basic EPS; future DPS floored at prior declared DPS per progressive dividend aspiration.

ar_nc.reason: Sum of three year-end balances / sum FY24-26 revenue. Apply to forecast revenue; not management working-capital days.
